verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a host-side view of currently connected peers, nor a way to disconnect a live session or revoke a device from the host. The closest items are Server Pro's audit logs, which are historical rather than live, and its per-user and device-group access control, which is an admin policy rather than a host disconnect/revoke action. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the host shows who is connected right now, and I can disconnect or revoke a device from the host
